missions.title: What should change?
missions.prompt: Say one thing that should change, using the target word, and give a reason.

missions.title: Two sides
missions.prompt: Describe a problem connected to the target word, contrast two possible responses, and state your view.

missions.title: Take a side
missions.prompt: Make an opinion statement using the target word. The next listener agrees or disagrees and gives one reason.
missions.listenerRole: Agree or disagree with the speaker and give one reason. This listener response is unscored.

missions.title: Defend your idea
missions.prompt: Use the target word in an opinion, then respond to one respectful challenge from the next listener.
missions.listenerRole: Challenge one part of the speaker’s idea respectfully. This listener response is unscored.

missions.title: This or that
missions.prompt: Name two familiar choices connected to the target word, compare them, and choose one.

missions.title: Plan together
missions.prompt: Your group has two options connected to the target word. Compare them and recommend one.

missions.title: Recommend it
missions.prompt: Recommend something to the next player using the target word, and explain one benefit.
missions.listenerRole: Listen for the benefit and ask one relevant follow-up. This listener response is unscored.

missions.title: Focused pitch
missions.prompt: Make a 45–60 second recommendation using the target word and supporting reasons.
missions.scoringNote: At EIKEN Pre-1, a developed pitch may earn 2 points; at EIKEN 2, one strong reason is enough for success.

missions.title: Find a difference
missions.prompt: Compare two familiar people, places, things, or ideas using the target word. The teacher may name the pair.

missions.title: Then and now
missions.prompt: Compare the past and present using the target word. EIKEN 2 and Pre-1 speakers also evaluate the change.

missions.title: Make it clear
missions.prompt: Use the target word explicitly in a clear situation, then add one detail that shows its meaning.

missions.title: Why it matters
missions.prompt: Use the target word to explain one real effect on a person, group, or society, with an example.

missions.title: Tell what happened
missions.prompt: Tell a short real, known, or clearly invented experience using the target word.

missions.title: Connect it to you
missions.prompt: Connect the target word to your day, a plan, or your future. You may use an imaginary situation.

missions.title: Solve a small problem
missions.prompt: Describe a small, familiar problem using the target word, then suggest one solution.

missions.title: Compare solutions
missions.prompt: Use the target word to explain a problem, compare two solutions, and choose one in 45–60 seconds.

missions.title: Imagine this
missions.prompt: Describe a possible situation connected to the target word and say what you would do.

missions.title: Change your usual day
missions.prompt: Imagine one concrete change at school, home, or in town. Use the target word to explain your response.

missions.title: Ask, listen, respond
missions.prompt: Ask the next listener a question using the target word, listen, then respond to the answer.
missions.listenerRole: Answer the speaker’s question briefly. The speaker then responds. This listener response is unscored.

missions.title: Keep it going
missions.prompt: The next listener asks one question. Answer with the target word, then ask that listener one follow-up.
missions.listenerRole: Ask the first relevant question, then answer the speaker’s follow-up. This listener response is unscored.

missions.title: Give a fresh example
missions.prompt: Speak to another person and give one fresh example that uses the target word. Do not copy a revealed model.

missions.title: Help someone
missions.prompt: Give a useful suggestion using the target word and explain why it could help.

missions.title: Short story
missions.prompt: Tell a connected story using the target word: two sentences at EIKEN 4/3, three at Pre-2, and a cause or consequence at higher levels.

stretch.prompt: If it fits naturally, include the bonus word too.

missions.title: Answer the listener
missions.prompt: The next listener asks a level-appropriate question. Answer using the target word and enough detail for your level.
missions.listenerRole: Ask one relevant, level-appropriate question. The speaker must use the target word in the answer.
